newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian, Fiat new car sales seen jumping in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Italian, Fiat new car sales seen jumping in Feb.

text.p: Italian new car registrations in February rose some 20 percent over February 1996 with Fiat group marques seeing sales up 23 to 25 percent, according to Fiat Auto MD Roberto Testore.
Testore gave the figures while attending the Geneva car show on Tuesday, a car sector source in Turin said.
Total Fiat orders in February were even better, posting a year-on-year rise of around 30 percent, Testore added.
Official Italian new car registration figures for February are due to be published by the Transport Ministry on Monday, March 10.
